stem: Based on the end of the story, what can the reader predict the rat will do?

options.label: F
options.text: He will try to become friends with the beetle and the parrot.

options.label: G
options.text: He will ask to race again because he feels the beetle won unfairly.

options.label: H
options.text: He will recognize how he could have won the race by working harder.

options.label: J
options.text: He will realize he was foolish to assume he was better than the beetle.
